avis.titre: Highly pigmented, long-lasting, and easy to apply for flawle
avis.texte: Highly pigmented, long-lasting, and easy to apply for flawless eye looksI've been really impressed with the BadGal Hypeliner! The color is rich and highly pigmented, it glides on smoothly, and dries quickly without smudging. It lasts for hours and is easy to remove with makeup remover. Perfect for creating both everyday and bold eye looks.

I loved this sunscreen!! I have tried lots of various mineral and chemical sunscreens, and this one is up there with the best. It's light and moisturizing, doesn't feel sticky or leave a white cast (at least on my fair skin). It does super well underneath my makeup as well. Keep in mind this is a mineral sunscreen so it's supposed to go on top of the rest of your skincare!! Overall, i'd definitely repurchase.

This sunscreen seemed promising because of some of the reviews however as someone with a normal skin type this felt so heavy on my skin. I tried wearing this without moisturizer to try and see if it would mitigate the feeling but it didn't. After the dry down, it felt balmy and pasty at the same time. I can see how someone with dry skin would like this but I do not.

I received Sum Bum Mineral 30 Sheer Suncreen Face Lotion from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I was excited to test out this product because I prefer to wear mineral sunscreen. Chemical sunscreen burns my eyes so I try to avoid it. I was impressed with how sheer the formula is. It applies as a white liquid but turns sheer as soon as you rub it into the skin. I appreciate that it is fragrance free. It did not irritate my sensitive skin and it was very hydrating. It might be too much if you have super oily skin. I liked how it made my dry skin look glowy.
I'm a fan of this sunscreen! Thin enough while offering great coverage and SPF. Does not irritate my sensitive skin, nor does it irritate my eyes, which is a win! Works well and reapplies just fine.

I used to love this suncreen when it was in the old packaging. You received more product and the quality was much better. Idk what changed but this looks horrible under my makeup. Splotchy and greasy.
This is a great mineral sunscreen. It takes awhile for it to absorb though. I love that there is no fragrance. The bottle it comes in is a great size to put it in your purse!
I love this product!!! I will very much purchase again. It's the only face sunscreen that doesn't leave my feeling oily and actually makes my makeup feel better than a primer
I like a lot. It's not greasy, wears really well under makeup and has high spf. Ive been reaching for it everyday. I would recommend this product.

avis.titre: I received Sun bum mineral Liquid Face 30 free from Influens
avis.texte: The texture is very lightweight and has a slight white cast as well. There is no scent noted and I became aware the more you rubbed it on or applied to your face it felt sticky. Also, it's water resistant up to 80 minutes. The lifespan of Sun Bum has a shelf life of 2 to 3 years from their manufacturing date. I would recommend this product to anyone who wants protection from the sun and enjoys the easy portability. Go on and give it a try, Sun Bum, literally save face.

This is a great product, it goes on very smooth and just a small amount gives you a lot of coverage. It goes on white but immediately blends into your skin with no residue. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all. It also does not leave your skin feeling oily or heavy. I also have not noticed that typical sunscreen scent, which is fantastic.

It was a good mineral sunscreen. It didn't give me a white cast and it blended really easily. You can even tell which one was the before/ after. There is a slight sunscreen smell but it didn't really affect my sensitive skin.

Best face sunscreen around! No purple cast finally! It's super smooth and lightweight, very very faint smell, lasts a good while and easy to apply. You get a lot in this bottle. Im getting one for my daughter and an extra for the car! Works well under makeup too! Love this product!
I really love this product. You can wear it under your makeup, which I love. It smells so good but it's light, it's not too much. It lasts so long, too!!!

This is my first time trying a face sunscreen and I was surprised by thin formula. It's lightweight, and absorbed pretty quickly. I have a deeper skin tone, and there was no white cast for me. It's has the typical sunscreen smell , but it's not overwhelming to me. I got a nice glow, but it didn't feel greasy or heavy. My daily look is concealer and eye makeup and it wore well on top of the sunscreen. Overall I think it's a solid sunscreen and will probably keep this in my rotation.
Sun Bum mineral Liquid Face SPF 30, is not so thick. It applies smoothly on, you don't have that strong thick feeling. The ingredients of this brand are good no gimmicks.

I love this sunscreen. It doesn't have a scent which is a huge plus for me and it doesn't leave a white cast on my face like other sunscreens I've tried in the past. I wish it just had a slightly higher SPF

avis.titre: Great daily spf, but long drying time
avis.texte: I recieved this spf product from Sun Bum and Influenster in exchange for my honest review! I have used a lot of spf products as I used spf every morning on my face. The main things I look for are no white cast, and no piling! This product covers both of those so I am very happy with it. I like the packaging and it is easy application without having to squeeze hard which I like. It is a more liquidy formula so it is a lot wetter upon application. My only complaint is that it takes some time to dry down compared to other products I typically use (~15-20 mins in my experience). So if you are not applying makeup over top daily, your skin will remain tacky for a period of time following application which can be annoying. Once it dries down it gives a nice healthy looking glow to the skin (it doesn't give wet which I like!) The product has no scent so did not cause any sensitivities, it did not clog my skin or cause me to break out at all which is great. Overall, it does what it is supposed to, makeup can applied over without pilling, there is little to no white cast (it applies quite white but as you rub in it goes clear), and it caused no irritation.

avis.titre: Sunbum would be the ones to invent perfect mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: This feels amazing, especially for a mineral sunscreen!! I survived beach trips & fishing trips with this. If you're needing a reef-safe sunscreen for Hawaii or the Caribbean, this is IT!! I put 6 drops of it on & it covered my arm in about 7 swipes. No more white glow!

avis.titre: Great for everyday even under makeup
avis.texte: I have used a few sun bum products and have always liked them. I have not been a huge fan on mineral sunscreen as they seem to either always leave a white cast or don't seem to blend in all the way. I am blown away by this product. It it lightweight, fragrance free and never broke me out like some face sunscreens can. I have wore this on no makeup days and worn it under makeup without any issues of it getting too greasy or making my makeup sit weird. Ot gives a nice glow to the skin but not an oily greasy feel. It has latest well throughout the day even if I've spent hours outside and have gotten sweaty it seems to stay well and doesn't burn my eyes either. Overall I'm very pleased with this product and will definitely purchase on my own.

avis.titre: The perfect amount of consistency, not too thick and not too
avis.texte: I used the Sun Bum spf 30 today while laying out at the pool. Overall I was very pleased with the product. It applied smoothly, was not too thick or greasy and gave me several hours of protection from the sun!

avis.titre: Blends great and no thick layer!!
avis.texte: I have never used a mineral sunscreen before to my knowledge so I wasn't sure if it would blend in as well as my usual sunscreen or leave a white residue but I was SO happy with this!! Sunbums products smell incredible and always feel so moisturizing and this was no exception. I have fairly acne prone skin and have had no issues with breakouts or irritation. I have used it in high uv pool days and didn't experience any burning either. For a face sunscreen it also is a great size and I would totally repurchase. The sunscreen I usually use this from my dermatologist and sometimes it isn't realistic to purchase, but I love how I could just run and grab this from the store if I needed something immediate. Can't wait to continue using this this summer and would 100% recommend!!

I have been using this sunscreen daily and I am impressed. The formula is lightweight and fragrance free and blends into the skin much better than any other sunscreen. it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy and provides reliable protection for every day. it sits well under makeup and doesn't irritate my skin and leaves my face feeling comfortable throughout the day. it's my favorite go to sunscreen. ￼￼￼￼￼

avis.titre: Perfect sun protection for your face
avis.texte: This Sun Bum Mineral Liquid Face 30 is a must have item for every face! The consistency is light enough to put under your makeup or perfect to keep in your purse when you find yourself suddenly in a situation where you are exposed to sun. A little goes a long way. It has excellent coverage. It doesn't irritate my skin or make my face look too shiny. It's a great ever addition to your skin care routine.

avis.titre: I found my new fave mineral face spf!!
avis.texte: A mineral spf that doesn't irritate,sting eyes or make me pasty white!Goes on liquidy smooth, feels like serum, perfect for dry skin & only slightly milky white after reapplying( but almost immediately blended awayi)My new holy grail for sunny days!!

I recently tried Sun Bum Mineral Liquid Face SPF 30 and have been very impressed with the results. The lightweight formula applies effortlessly, absorbs quickly, and never feels greasy or heavy on my skin. I especially appreciate that it's a mineral sunscreen, which makes it ideal for sensitive skin. It offers reliable sun protection while remaining comfortable enough for everyday wear. Overall, it's an excellent addition to my skincare routine, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking effective daily sun protection.￼
I was outside for hours and I reapplied the sunscreen when the directions say so and I didn't burn at all. I am very fair skinned and I'm so surprised how well this sunscreen works.
Sun Bum is a great product, I love how packaging is easy to apply I feel comfortable using it, i love how it is long lasting texture with a good ingredients.

I love this lightweight sun protectant! It leaves the skin feeling soft like lotion, not greasy. The scent is gentle and doesn't stay around. Protects well in the sun while still being a sustainable, socially conscious product!

avis.titre: Give it a try, one of the best I have tried
avis.texte: This is a great sunscreen! I have tan combo skin and I don't feel like it makes me overly greasy and has a minimal white cast. It layers well under makeup but I do feel like after a couple reapplications my skin started to feel really clogged up. However I didn't get any weird reactions or breakouts of anything. I'd say overall it's a really good solid option. It's also thin enough to smooth on skin nicely but not watery.

avis.titre: Silky skin not shiny or goopy
avis.texte: Great design for a sunscreen on the go. Love the mineral ingredients and the feel of the product both as it is applied and after. Skin feels silky smooth to the touch and is not shiny. or goopy. This sunscreen is a great value for the money.

avis.titre: A lightweight mineral sunscreen that offers reliable protect
avis.texte: I really enjoy this mineral sunscreen. It feels lightweight, good blends and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I also love that it's fragrance free and provides reliable sun protection for everyday wear. The packaging is compact and easy to carry in a bag, and the formula provides comfortable, long lasting protection.

I love this sunscreen. I use it every day on my face! My skin is very sensitive and acne-prone, and I have had no issues with using this product on my face. My face seems clearer with this sunscreen than with others I have tried. The product is very easy to rub in and sits nicely on my skin without leaving a white cast. It initially is very dewy when first applied, but the product sinks into the skin well. My skin gets oily throughout the day, and I find this product works well without being too drying.

This is truly one of my favorite sunscreens I've ever tried. It's so smooth to apply and blends effortlessly with no white cast at all. It does make you look a little shiny but I wouldn't say greasy or oilly like many others. I wore it on vacation and got burnt everywhere but exactly where it was applyed. Even in water it still continued to provide protection to my skin.

avis.titre: Lightweight mineral sunscreen that blends easy and wears com
avis.texte: I love this mineral sunscreen. The formula is lightweight amd easy to blend compared to many minerals sunscreens. It absorbed quickly, feels good on my skin and provides good coverage without feeling heavy. The finsh is natural and not overly greasy. I also appreciate it layers well under makeup amd doesn't have a strong scent. Overall its a grate option for daily sunscreen.

I love me some Sun Bum! This was the first time I tried the mineral sunscreen. It's more thin than thick, but it's good! Easy to blend in. Right after it appears rather shiny, but it dries down nicely! Fragrance free, too!

As a fair skinned person who is often at the pool, I have a hard time finding a lightweight sunscreen that doesn't make my face feel clogged and heavy. The sunscreen went on, smooth and stayed strong, even while sweating. The size was perfect to pack my pool bag.

I like how this sunscreen doesn't leave a white cast on my skin, however you do feel it, so not a completely "melt away" texture. I honestly don't mind it. I enjoy the packaging and find it easy to apply as well! Spill proof is great.

A good everyday sunscreen for sensitive skin. It feels a little greasy until absorbed. I would avoid if your skin is oily. It goes on white and drys clear. Provides good protection when applied correctly. There is no scent.

avis.titre: Great mineral sunscreen to wear under makeup or alone.
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen. I normally don't go for mineral options, but this one does the trick. I wore it a few times, under makeup and also alone on the skin. Initially right after applying it does feel a bit greasy/sticky, but after a few minutes it absorbs and leaves my skin feeling moisturized instead of greasy or oily. I like the squeeze packaging, it's thin but not watery. Overall I think this is a great product and I would repurchase.
I used this product on my baby and myself. It worked great for both of us! It's lightweight and doesn't feel super heavy like a lot of mineral sunscreens do.
Mineral sunscreen is always my favorite as jt contains no chemicals and no harm to skin. It also has no white cast so I highly recommend it. Very easy to use with effective results

I am not new to Sun Bum so this product is no different than their others. I love it! I have a very sensitive face and this mineral sunscreen is so light and soft. It goes on easily and doesn't leave my face white or slimy feeling. This is the perfect size to carry around with me in the Florida sun.

Has worked great under my makeup with no issues and feels nice on the skin. Smells good and has worked to protect me from the sun. Usually don't like face sunscreens but this one is a great consistency.

In love this sunscreen it's not oily or greasy looking it feels lightweight and it's very good for the skin I love the ingredients and the removal is easy good on skin you're skin will thank you later

avis.titre: Light weight, no white cast and non greasy
avis.texte: I really like this mineral sunscreen. It feels lightweight, blends in well and provides reliable SPF 30 protection without feeling greasy. The packaging is convenient, and it leaves my skin looking smooth and comfortable throughout the day.

Overall an ok mineral sunscreen. No fragrance smooth absorbable texture. Feels light and smooth. In the picture above the little squirt of product is how it looks "absorbed" I'd imagine it might leave a semi white cast on certain skin tones. It does appear somewhat "shiny" on the skin. Overall good but I prefer other more matte SPF for my face

The texture of this was nice and light and I am hoping it feels that way during the very humid summer months as well. I used it on a very hot day and didn't feel like it was eating off, so that was a plus, however the humidity can be brutal here, so that would be the next test.

The sun bum mineral 30 sheer sunscreen is overall pretty effective but the reason I did not give it 5 stars is because I still think it felt a little greasy to me. It does go in sheer but there's that light greasy feeling I got every time I used it, good news is that it's not sticky and it does work. I have very fair skin that burns easily and during my daily walks I have used this and have not burned or even turned red. Overall it's a good product but I do wish someone could do something about sunscreens being greasy!

avis.titre: Good mineral option for light sun exposure
avis.texte: Great mineral face sunscreen for light sun exposure. This sunscreen applies easily and leaves absolutely no white cast. It's definitely not matte, but more of a 'dewy' appearance, which I personally prefer. Feels light on the face, not too heavy or greasy. I just wish the spf was higher for more sun protection with sport or at the beach.

Provided ample protection for my medium complexion skin while outside in the sun for a few hours. Did not experience burning. Sunscreen melted into skin without a heavy feeling. No greasiness, no white streaks, just full coverage. Definitely recommend!

I love this sunscreen! Living in sunny California, sunscreen is a must for me. Goes on smooth and doesn't feel greasy and no white residue at all. Leaves me skin feeling beautiful and dewy! It lasts a long time, which is great for those sun filled beach days! It's amazing for hikes as well, the size is perfect for my small crossbody bag. Sun Bum has done it again, love their products! I'm already recommending it to my friends!

I took this Sunscreen with me to the pool and really liked it. It wasn't greasy ,didnt irrate my skin and provided good sun protection. I also appreciate that it's fragrance free since my skin can be sensitive. So far I'm happy with it and would use it again.…
Super easy application and packaging. It felt super nice on my face and was able to apply makeup on top of it! It was also super easy to wash off at the end of the day but lasted throughout the day!

I apply this as my last step in my morning skincare routine. I love how this goes on and absorbs quickly without leaving me feeling greasy. And no whitecast. Perfectly sized to take with you for travel to the beach or to the pool.

I was thrilled to review this sunscreen from Sun Bum! We have tried so many brands.., from cheap to high end to middle of the road as far as price is concerned. My husband had skin cancer (face) so we have explored all and I will say this one is fantastic! We all love it for the fact that it goes on white and ends up clear and NO greasy feel at all!! That is a must for my teens and acne prone skin! I applied this on my face and ears and even hands before I headed out to my backyard pool. I also tried it under makeup and it worked perfect for me! I usually wear an SPF 15 but will definitely use this instead because of the SPF 30. As far as the scent goes, I didn't smell anything and that is an added bonus because I am not a huge fan of any chemical smell. I will definitely buy again and recommend and the size is perfect to pop in a bag or take traveling. My son just used it yesterday on his school field trip to an amusement park and it was a sunny day and he came home without a burn except for his neck because he didn't apply it there!!

avis.titre: Sheer, spread easily, no white caste
avis.texte: Great sunscreen!! Comes easily in my handbag, no fragrance, spreads easily on face. Water proof can be used for swimming and stays long. Mineral not chemical. Has no white cast at all.

I love Sun Bum sunscreen and particularly love the smell! I was bummed to find that the mineral doesn't have the yummy smell and smells like a typical non-scented sunscreen (almost plastic like), but it is made for sensitive skin, so I know a lot of people would enjoy this fact and I'm not sure you wanted a scented sunscreen on your face! This goes on great for a mineral sunscreen and feels more like a typical sunscreen than the thick, white mineral sunscreen that's hard to rub in. This glides on easy, the applicator is great (a little goes a long way) and it's small enough for on the go every day use in a bag. I'm not sure if this comes in a higher SPF, but I typically look for 50 or higher, because I am pale and live in AZ, which I have a hard time finding for facial SS. This does feel a little greasy for facial sunscreen at first, but it does dry down after 5-10 mins of wear. If this was made a little less greasy and with a higher SPF, I would LOVE that.

I been using it for a little over a week. I received many compliments saying my skin looks radiant even under my makeup. It blends super easy. At first it does look white but it blends with your skin. It doesn't have a scent and hasn't caused any irritation or break outs on my skin. I really like it.
I really love this sunscreen ! I love when sunscreens are thin and light weight and this one definitely is. Also looks clear once applied. Also love how sun bum products smell!

let me start by saying, i absolutely love the packaging of this sunscreen. the dropper allows you to get just the right amount for a face application. i also love the consistency and finish of this product, it is super lightweight and non-greasy. the only downside to this product is the fact that is isn't suitable for my melanated skin tones and leaves and awful white cast as does most sunscreens. i'm disappointed because i would love to add spf into my skincare regimen but it is a constant struggle for the chocolate girls. overall it doesn't work for me but might be wonderful for someone else.

avis.titre: Lightweight mineral sunscreen with a natural finish
avis.texte: I really enjoyed trying Sun Bum Mineral Liquid Face 30. The texture is very lightweight and blends into my skin much easier than many mineral sunscreens I've used before. It absorbed quickly without feeling greasy or heavy, and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin or cause breakouts. I also like that it gave my skin a soft natural finish instead of looking overly shiny. The package is small and easy to carry in my purse or travel bag. The shade matches my skin surprisingly well with only slightly white cast at first disappeared after blending. Overall, this is comfortable every day sunscreen that feels gentle and easy to wear under makeup.
Lightning mineral sunscreen with good protection and absorption, though it may leave a slight white cast initially. Good option for everyday use
This face lotion is PHENOMENAL! it doesn't run into your eyes, it makes your skin radiant, it has zero scent and ingot no breakouts from it! This is definitely going to be my new beach bag staple

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and daily use
avis.texte: This is Sun Bum Mineral SPF 30: Sheer, water-resistant protection that's gentle on sensitive skin. Shield your sensitive skin daily with water-resistant formula glides on smoothly without a greasy feel, providing reliable protection you can trust. formula is perfect for daily use, leaving your sensitive skin feeling smooth, not greasy. Stay protected and comfortable all day long!

I love this brand! It's one of my favorite American mineral sunscreen brands (aside from Korean brands). The formula does leave a slight white cast, but all mineral sunscreens do. It's healthier/safer than chemical sunscreens. The upside to a mineral sunscreen formula is that you know when to reapply it. The scent was pleasant because it was nearly odorless, but had a slight coconut-like/gentle subtlety to the formula. The package size was great because it was also easy to travel with on-the-go. The dispenser tip was a narrow point, so was also easy to control how much fluid came out.

This comes with me everywhere! Living in sunny California, sunscreen is a must. I love how small and secure the packaging is. I have not had to deal with any spillage or leaking so far. It is almost odorless, not a scent I notice or that lingers. It blends nicely into my skin to ensure complete coverage. The finish is dewy and hydrated. My skin feels moisturized throughout the day.

Recommend and necessary for this brand of this type of sunscreen very liquid so that it feels light and not too heavy it's the whites liquid but doesn't leave a white residue just spread it well , it's doesn't dry completely but it feels very good on the face I would like the to extend the duration of the protection a little more of 30 but that's just the formula that needs improvement but overall everything is excellent with this mineral sunscreen

As someone who has tried endless mineral spfs I do think the one is a great option. It is lightweight, a watery texture and applies nicely. It does take a bit to work into the skin and has a white cast however the white cast did go away after rubbing it in and allowing time for it to settle. It is on the oily side and very wet. I did place powder over it as I am oily skin girly. I do like it, I think k I will reach for it on the days I desire a low spf that is mineral.

Sun Bum makes good sunscreens. I like that this is mineral-based because we want to keep chemicals off our bodies and out of the water. I also like that it's SPF 30 instead of a higher number, since I think 30 is the perfect balance of protection and allowing some tanning. The sunscreen applied nicely and doesn't feel greasy, rubbing in clear without much effort. If you are looking for a good mineral face sunscreen, Sun Bum Mineral Face Sunscreen is great quality and works perfectly without a white mineral cast.

Sun Bum Mineral SPF 30 is a great sunscreen for days spent gardening and landscaping. It absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky residue, which is a big deal when I'm outside for hours. I also love that it's completely unscented. It feels light in the skin and never competes with makeup. Keeps me protected all day in the sun and stays comfortable even when I'm sweating. Works without calling attention to itself.

avis.titre: Long lasting goes on smooth and does not leave a white cast!
avis.texte: I think I've just found my new favorite face sunscreen! Sun Bum's Mineral Liquid sunscreen goes on smooth, it is fragrance free and has a SPF of 30. I like that it has the the zinc oxide and is water resistant for 80 minutes. I find that it is light weight and didn't leave a white cast which is important to me. I used this sunscreen under my tinted moisturizer. I applied it in the morning and went to an all day music festival. I did not need to reapply and my face was protected from the sun all day. I am so impressed!
I used it on my last vacation and I love it. It is absorbed favorably leaving a light and fresh texture on the face. The packaging is small which makes it practical to carry in any bag. 10/10

avis.titre: Lightweight Mineral Sunscreen That Wears Well Daily
avis.texte: This mineral sunscreen surprised me in a good way. It feels lightweight for a mineral formula and blends into the skin much easier than I expected. And actually felt moisturizing and left my skin soft. The sheer finish helps avoid that heavy white cast look, and it layers nicely under makeup or other skincare products. It leaves my skin feeling protected without feeling greasy or overly thick. Great everyday face sunscreen option, especially if you prefer mineral sunscreens.

Okaaaaay. Packaging is so chic. Mess free. Clean. Product application is NOT greasy, feels like a hydrating lotion. I have sensitive skin and this has been great! Not clotting, not acne inducing. So far so good!
I am a sunscreen expert and I love this stuff. I have acne prone skin and haven't noticed breakouts due to using this. It comes out of the bottle nice and stays on my skin.

Lightweight texture. I didn't notice or feel any greasy shine after applying it. It feels very comfortable on my face skin. I am very sensitive to smells, so I really liked that this sunscreen is completely fragrance free.
I'm loving it, excellent texture, neutral smell, duration and quality, an adjustment that can be seen from the first application, delighted with this product, recommended
A new staple for summer! This formula easily blends into my skin and has a sheer shine to it. Provides lasting coverage and was gentle on my skin. Will definitely be buying again.

I love this product. It goes smoothly on your skin and feels silky and not too thick. The scent is very mild and definitely not overpowering, which I really like. I also like the idea that you can swim with it and it lasts a longtime, being waterproof.
Lightweight, durable sunscreen. Great on sensitive skin. Slightly oily but easy to apply. The applicator is easy to use and dispense. Lasts for hours.

avis.titre: Lightweight sunscreen perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using this sunscreen and I really like it because it feels super lightweight on the skin, doesn't feel greasy, and gives great sun protection. Since it's mineral and fragrance-free, it doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts. Perfect for everyday use. It absorbs super fast into the skin and lasts a long time. I really liked it.
So far the texture of the Sun Bum mineral liquid face 30spf lotion is wonderful. It blends so well without leaving white residue. It's also pretty light weight and feels so smooth.

avis.titre: Great light feeling mineral based sunscreen
avis.texte: Love this sunscreen. The mineral formula is light and a great base for my make up routine before I go out in the sun. It blends into my skin and doesn't leave a strange residue unlike other brands.
Great Sunscreen for daily use. I applied before I put my make up on, leaves my face hydrated witouth leaving my face white. Its starts off a little oily but that goes away pretty much instantly.
Pleasant coconut scent. I love the cute and sleek packaging. Does not apply heavy- very light and feels light. Value seems very high for the quality and quantity.

avis.titre: This is a must-have because it features a lightweight, zinc-
avis.texte: The star of the show here is Zinc Oxide (19.2%), a physical mineral blocker. Unlike chemical sunscreens that absorb UV rays, this sits on top of your skin like a tiny shield to bounce UVA and UVB rays away. It is completely fragrance-free. While it doesn't give you those beachy vibes, it's a massive win for anyone whose skin flares up, breaks out, or gets irritated by artificial perfumes.

I've always been a fan of Sun Bum products and this mineral face sunscreen did NOT disappoint. It's gentle and fragrance free for sensitive skin, but the best part is how smooth and easy it absorbs! The older products with zinc oxide left an embarrassing and obvious white color and finish, but this gets the job done without any residue or signs of application!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Super smooth feel and even application. Wore well over moisturizer and under makeup. Nice natural finish; not too matte or too glowy. Little to no scent.

Sun Bum is one of my go to brands for sunscreen! I love that this face sunscreen has zinc oxide and goes on smooth without your face looking white. It is also great for my sensitive skin. I have never broken out using it!
Application is soo smooth! No irritation! great coverage and the finish feels so smooth! I love this brand it's clean and smells so good! I will be buying more
This sunscreen has been heaven sent during baseball season. It has a great texture and comes in a package that is easy to transport. The finish is soft and smells amazing.

avis.titre: Definitely a sunscreen I would keep using.
avis.texte: I have been using the sunscreen lately and honestly I really loved it. It's super lightweight, melts into the skin so well, it doesn't feel heavy or greasy at all. I also like that it's fragrance free, specially for sensitive skin. The only thing I wish is that it was SPF 50 instead of 30, but overall it leaves my skin smooth and protected.

avis.titre: Felt moisturized while getting protection from sun
avis.texte: The Sun Bum sunscreen face lotion goes on smooth and is lightweight, however it does leave slightly oily finish, like many other sunscreen lotions. It blended well and didn't leave white residue. My skin felt moisturized while getting protection from sun.

I like the consistency of this. It feels good on the skin and does not clog my pores. There's also no white cast residue left behind after applying. The sunscreen smell of this product also is not as strong compared to others I've used in the past. However, whenever I apply makeup on my face after using this, it always causes pilling. I've tried using different products or even moisturizing more, but that doesn't seem to help. Good for beach days or everyday if you don't use makeup.
Love the sheer application! Unlike the majority of mineral sunscreens, no white cats at all! Doesn't have a fragrance, so it's perfect for my sensitive skin. Wish the UV protection was higher

This sunblock is smooth and silky, absorbs easily without a thick greasy feel. Virtually unscented so you don't have a heavy scent and lightweight feeling when it's rubbed in. It held up well all day in the pool and best of all performed well on adults and kids.

This sunscreen is fragrance free so that is a number one for me! It lays on lightly and doesnt leave your skin extremely greasy! It feels great and doesnt great! Its very buildable! The feeling and performance is miraculous!
Love this product, it's doesn't feel heavy on the skin. it doesn't leave whites spots once apply witch is perfect. Water resistant and doesn't have a strong smell. 100% recommend.

I liked the is liquid Mineral sunscreen for the face. It dissolves easily into my skin and is not greasy at all. It is super lightweight, so it is nice to wear under my makeup. It has a really faint smell that is nice.

This product surprised me. I feel like most mineral sunscreens leave that white overcast. Not this one! It dries down nicely. It doesn't make the skin too sticky, blends out nicely. You could layer makeup on it no problem. The size of the bottle makes it easy to take on the go. Definitely something I'll be using daily!

The Sun Bum Mineral Liquid Face Sunscreen is perfect by itself or under makeup. It blends in well and doesn't leave a white cast. It absorbs quickly and it is long lasting. I love that it is a good-sized squeeze bottle that is easy to use. A little also goes a long ways. This product was provided to me by Influenster for testing and honest review.
Love this! Greet under make up. Smells good. Nice coverage . Absorbed well. I will continue to use . Last all day under make up. Def would purchase

avis.titre: A need for every summer beach bag!
avis.texte: This mineral sunscreen is great! The besy thing is - clean ingredients! It goes on white but becomes sheer as you rub it in. No left over residue once it's been rubbed in, and no slimy or sticky feeling. You don't even notice it's on and could easily be worn under makeup. Very light vanilla scent.

Sun Bum products are great for the beach or everyday use. Most sunscreens have an awful smell and make me not want to use them but this one has a great smell like with their other products. I also appreciate that it's a mineral sunscreen making it better for my skin.
With a light, comfortable feel. Easy to apply and comes in a super practical package. This daily sunscreen is excellent for your skincare routine, and comes in a generous amount.
Very durable packaging with super effective ingredients. Great wear time with a really efficient absorption rate. Great results when wearing this sun lotion!

This sunscreen feels amazing on the skin! There is little to no scent and the packaging is small enough to throw in your purse on the travel! Lots of consistency and it's durable which is a must during summer!

I love the formula for the most part. It's so lightweight, really easy to blend the white cast out, not greasy, and not drying. Even though it is not greasy, it looks really oily on the skin which is probably fine if you are outdoors at the beach, but not ideal for everyday wear. I have combo skin with a somewhat oily t-zone to provide some context.

avis.titre: Perfect for summer or any day use! Blends nicely to skin
avis.texte: Perfect for outdoors! I used this to sit outside this morning in 98 degree weather! It blended it nicely and left a glow behind! I didn't get sunburnt and I enjoyed the beautiful weather!

This sunscreen is the perfect size for my purse when I need it to go or travel. It's lightweight and not sticky which I love! There's not really a scent but I feel that's better! Picture reference on my arm to show you how it makes your skin glowy !
This sunscreen is lightweight and it applies smoothly to my face. It instantly absorbs into my skin. I love that this sunscreen is fragrance-free and it doesn't irritate my skin.
I love this sunscreen!!! It's lightweight and does not feel greasy. You can wear it under your makeup and it won't pill. I also love that it's fragrance free and perfect for sensitive skin!!!

I just tried this sunscreen and really like the first impression. It's fragrance free no no noticeable scent, which is great for sensitive skin and for people who very picky about fragrance like me. The texture feels smooth and lightweight, not grease or heavy, and it easily blends into the skin. It also sits nicely under makeup. It feels comfortable for everyday wear and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily.

This spf really feels like a lotion! I really enjoy the non greasy feeling! It melts into the skin and it lasted around 80 min pretty standard! If you're looking for something more hydrating and good for your face this is the one for you!
This smells great and is so easy to apply. No white cast. You can wear in the sun and reapply. Smooth. Only issue is it's not pregnancy safe due to some ingredients.
The product is easy to rub in and doesn't leave a white cast on skin. It adds a dewy finish, so it's a sheer application. The sunscreen has a light consistency.

Amazing very cute package and the finish was really good on my skin it is very lightweight on my skin and it doesn't let your face be white though. There is no smell on it which I think is good and I need to use the pool to check it out how It's gonna be.
This sunscreen made my face feel sticky and greasy. It also made my face very shiny. Please bring back the old formula!

Feels so smooth on the skin, I use it every day on my arms and neck and it rubs in quite well despite being mineral. I am extremely pale but a chalky sunscreen could look white casty on my skin and this one doent do that. Plus it doesnt smell bad at all

I just wish this was SPF 50 but it is still a very nice sunscreen. Maybe I have drier skin but i thought this looked beautiful and dried down very quickly. It didnt leave any white cast which is amazing (I thought everyone just made up that it didnt leave a whitecast because its so uncommon lol) but they were right! Great price too and it still has good protection. I really like it.

avis.titre: I did not burn and feel silky smooth!
avis.texte: Nice scent, went on smooth and felt great all day! Great ingredients, It was super effective and I did not burn in the Florida sun and it was beautifully packaged!

I love Sun Bum. Recently bought the Sheer Mineral face and love it. We are on Pensacola Beach this week and in the sun every day all day and do not feel that oily feel I do with the other Sun Bum face product. I am a devoted SB user!!!
